scope: Local synthetic intermediate experiment during motion-v4 implementation; not final acceptance or physical vehicle evidence

experiment.behavior_difference: Among candidates passing all existing hard gates, experimentally prefer those whose modeled stopping disk remains clear one control period later; comparison uses original trajectory score ordering.
experiment.current_emergency_gate: Unchanged: full body radius + clearance + two control periods + braking distance at max(measured speed, candidate target speed). Lower targets do not shrink this gate.
experiment.retained: Current, selected-command and next-period stopping-margin diagnostics only; original score ordering retained.

intermediate_outcomes.interpretation: The preference caused an earlier PP cone-stage deadlock. Original ordering still had a separate intermediate PP light-approach failure; these runs are not claimed as final passes.

first_preference_failure.grid_rejection: All 44 candidate rollouts first fail the diagonal-neighbor rule on cell (43,34) -> (44,33); the intervening orthogonal cell (43,33) is occupied. Both sampled endpoint cells are free.

constraining_neighbor.source: synthetic laser ray 85 (zero based), second cone

first_preference_failure.continuation: From 19100 ms no_forward_kinematic_path; stopped at 19300 ms; ordinary-stop timeout at 29400 ms.

independent_reconstruction.method: Reconstruct all 360 synthetic laser returns and logged visual cone coordinates, original grid inflation, speed/curvature ramps, integration and diagonal-neighbor checks; Python arithmetic only, not a second full controller run.
excluded_explanations: A newly occupied cell caused only by the latest scan
The current measured pose already being inside an occupied grid cell
Lateral acceleration or current emergency stopping-disk rejection

cached_route_context.interpretation: Actual tracking moved inside the cached bend before the grid corner. Constant-target previews then all encounter the conservative corner rule. This does not prove that every possible future steering policy is infeasible, or that physical collision occurred.
